letter_size.rule: Recommend only when the exact requested size exists in product_variants_final.csv and available is true.

waist_size.rule: For trousers, jeans, skirts and similar products, match the exact numeric waist size when available.

shoe_size.rule: Recommend only the exact shoe size available for that product.

collar_size.rule: For formal shirts, use the exact collar size when the product uses collar-size variants.

confidence_rules.high: Exact requested size exists and available is true.
confidence_rules.medium: Product matches style/category but user did not provide a size.
confidence_rules.low: Size information is incomplete; show product only with a clear warning.

safety_rules: Never create a size that does not exist in the retailer data.
Never convert body measurements to a brand size unless a verified brand size chart is available.
If the requested size is unavailable, show alternative products with the requested size instead.
